key_idea: Simulate years t=1,2,... until both (ds+t) mod ys and (dm+t) mod ym are zero.
sketch: The answer is guaranteed to be at most 5000, so loop t from 1 upward and print the first t with (ds+t)%ys==0 and (dm+t)%ym==0. O(5000). Start from t=1, not 0, since no eclipse is happening now. CRT is overkill.
